revision.text:
{{otheruses|Nine Stars of Divination|Nine Stars in Indian Astronomy|Nine Luminaries}} {{Cite source|date=December 2018}} {{color}} '''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}}, Kyūsei) is a form of [[folk belief]] originating from ancient [[China]], consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.
The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."
== Origin == The Nine Stars system originates from the following {{ill|magic square|ja|魔方陣}}:
{| class="wikitable" |- |Four||Nine||Two |- |Three||Five||Seven |- |Eight||One||Six |}
In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. These numbers are paired with seven colors (white, black, blue, green, yellow, red, and purple), the {{ill|five elements|ja|五行思想}} ({{ill|wood|ja|木}}, {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|earth|ja|土}}, {{ill|metal|ja|金}}, and {{ill|water|ja|水}}), the {{ill|ten heavenly stems|ja|十干}}, the {{ill|twelve earthly branches|ja|十二支}}, and the {{ill|eight trigrams|ja|八卦}} of {{ill|I Ching|ja|易経}}. When these numbers shift positions, interpretations are added to form the "Nine Stars."
According to legend, {{ill|Yu the Great|ja|禹}}, founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Luo Writing|ja|洛書}}), one of the {{ill|River Chart and Luo Writing|ja|河図洛書}}.

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wu Xing|ja|五行思想}} - Metal * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Dui (兌) * {{ill|Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * {{ill|Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - {{ill|September|ja|9月}} * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei
== Years in Which Shichiseki Kinsei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 4 are Shichiseki Kinsei years.

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wu Xing|ja|五行思想}} - Metal * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Dui (兌) * {{ill|Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * {{ill|Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - {{ill|September|ja|9月}} * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei
== Years in Which Shichiseki Kinsei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 4 are Shichiseki Kinsei years.

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing|lt=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|ja|五行思想}} - Metal * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Dui (兌) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - {{ill|September|ja|9月}} * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Metal * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Dui (兌) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - {{ill|September|ja|9月}} * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei
== Years in Which Shichiseki Kinsei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 4 are Shichiseki Kinsei years.
‥‥- [[1948]] - [[1957]] - [[1966]] - [[1975]] - [[1984]] - [[1993]] - [[2002]] - [[2011]] - [[2020]] - [[2029]] - [[2038]] - [[2047]] - [[2056]] - [[2065]] - [[2074]]<nowiki> - ‥‥

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Metal * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Dui (兌) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - {{ill|September|ja|9月}} * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Metal * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Dui (兌) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - {{ill|September|ja|9月}} * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei
== Years in Which Shichiseki Kinsei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 4 are Shichiseki Kinsei years.

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Metal * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Dui (兌) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - {{ill|September|ja|9月}} * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei
== Years in Which Shichiseki Kinsei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 4 are Shichiseki Kinsei years.

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Metal * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Dui (兌) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - {{ill|September|ja|9月}} * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei
== Years in Which Shichiseki Kinsei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 4 are Shichiseki Kinsei years.
‥‥- [[1948]] - [[1957]] - [[1966]] - [[1975]] - [[1984]] - [[1993]] - [[2002]] - [[2011]] - [[2020]] - [[2029]] - [[2038]] - [[2047]] - [[2056]] - [[2065]] - [[2074]][[Category:nowiki former opening]] - ‥‥

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Metal * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Dui (兌) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - {{ill|September|ja|9月}} * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Metal * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Dui (兌) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - {{ill|September|ja|9月}} * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei
== Years in Which Shichiseki Kinsei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 4 are Shichiseki Kinsei years.

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Metal * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Dui (兌) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - {{ill|September|ja|9月}} * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Metal * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Dui (兌) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - {{ill|September|ja|9月}} * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Metal * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Dui (兌) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - {{ill|September|ja|9月}} * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei
== Years in Which Shichiseki Kinsei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 4 are Shichiseki Kinsei years.
‥‥- [[1948]] - [[1957]] - [[1966]] - [[1975]] - [[1984]] - [[1993]] - [[2002]] - [[2011]] - [[2020]] - [[2029]] - [[2038]] - [[2047]] - [[2056]] - [[2065]] - [[2074]]- ‥‥

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Metal * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Dui (兌) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - {{ill|September|ja|9月}} * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Metal * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Dui (兌) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - {{ill|September|ja|9月}} * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|1=Ninth Purple Fire Star|ja|九紫火星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei
== Years in Which Shichiseki Kinsei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 4 are Shichiseki Kinsei years.
‥‥- [[1948]] - [[1957]] - [[1966]] - [[1975]] - [[1984]] - [[1993]] - [[2002]] - [[2011]] - [[2020]] - [[2029]] - [[2038]] - [[2047]] - [[2056]] - [[2065]] - [[2074]]- ‥‥

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Metal * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Dui (兌) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - {{ill|September|ja|9月}} * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|1=Ninth Purple Fire Star|ja|九紫火星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei
== Years in Which Shichiseki Kinsei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 4 are Shichiseki Kinsei years.
‥‥- [[1948]] - [[1957]] - [[1966]] - [[1975]] - [[1984]] - [[1993]] - [[2002]] - [[2011]] - [[2020]] - [[2029]] - [[2038]] - [[2047]] - [[2056]] - [[2065]] - [[2074]]- ‥‥

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Metal * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Dui (兌) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - {{ill|September|ja|9月}} * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|1=Ninth Purple Fire Star|ja|九紫火星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星}}, Shichiseki Kinsei
== Years in Which Shichiseki Kinsei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 4 are Shichiseki Kinsei years.

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|12=draft}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦|12=draft}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い|12=draft}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|12=draft}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想|12=draft}} - Metal * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦|12=draft}} - Dui (兌) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干|12=draft}} - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支|12=draft}} - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - {{ill|September|ja|9月|12=draft}} * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|12=draft}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|12=draft}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=draft}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=draft}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star|12=draft}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=draft}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|1=Ninth Purple Fire Star|ja|九紫火星|12=draft}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|12=draft}}, Shichiseki Kinsei
== Years in Which Shichiseki Kinsei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 4 are Shichiseki Kinsei years.

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ 七赤が中宮の場合 |- | 六 || 二 || 四 |- | 五 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 七 || 九 |- | 一 || 三 || 八 |}
'''七赤金星'''（しちせききんせい）とは、[[暦]]、[[占い]]に用いられる[[九星]]の一つ。後天定位盤において西に位置する。
六白金星と同じ金に属するが、七赤金星は、金としては精錬された金属を表すという。
日の九星においては、冬至前後に九星の閏を置く場合、その期間中の甲午の日を七赤として陰遁から陽遁に切り替わる。その際前の陰遁最終日と合わせて七赤が2日続く。
==属性== *[[五行思想|五行]] - 金 *[[八卦]] - 兌 *[[十干]] - 庚、辛 *[[十二支]] - 酉 *季節 - 秋 *方位 - 西 *月 - [[9月]] *時間 - 17時～19時 *数 - 四、九 *色 - 白色 *味 - 辛味
==象意== *喜び、弁舌、終末、引退、金銭、口論、祝賀会、結婚式、不十分、不注意、毒舌、 *恋愛、レジャー、財、少女、集まる、食べる、右肺、口中、歯、咽頭、気管支、神経衰弱
==他の星との関係（相性）== *相生 - [[一白水星]]（金生水）、[[二黒土星]]（土生金）、[[五黄土星]]（土生金）、[[八白土星]]（土生金） *相克 - [[三碧木星]]（金剋木）、[[四緑木星]]（金剋木）、[[九紫火星]]（火剋金） *比和 - [[六白金星]]、七赤金星
==七赤金星の（中宮になる）年== 西暦年を9で割って4余る年が七赤金星の年となる。
‥‥- [[1948年]] - [[1957年]] - [[1966年]] - [[1975年]] - [[1984年]] - [[1993年]] - [[2002年]] - [[2011年]] - [[2020年]] - [[2029年]] - [[2038年]] - [[2047年]] - [[2056年]] - [[2065年]] - [[2074年]] - ‥‥
{{DEFAULTSORT:しちせききんせい}} [[Category:九星]] [[Category:金星|しちせききんせい]]

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|2=ja|3=五行思想|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=}} - Metal * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bagua|qq=}} - Dui (兌) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Heavenly Stems|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Heavenly Stems|qq=}} - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=}} - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - {{ill|September|ja|9月|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/September|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/September|qq=}} * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|2=ja|3=五行思想|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=}} - Metal * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bagua|qq=}} - Dui (兌) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Heavenly Stems|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Heavenly Stems|qq=}} - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=}} - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - {{ill|September|ja|9月|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/September|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/September|qq=}} * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - '''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|2=ja|3=五行思想|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=}} - Metal * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bagua|qq=}} - Dui (兌) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Heavenly Stems|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Heavenly Stems|qq=}} - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=}} - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - {{ill|September|ja|9月|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/September|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/September|qq=}} * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - '''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) -
