{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - '''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - '''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - '''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Metal * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Dui (兌) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - You (酉) * Season - Autumn * Direction - West * Month - [[:en:September|September]] * Time - 17:00–19:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Shichiseki is in the center |- | 6 || 2 || 4 |- | 5 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 7 || 9 |- | 1 || 3 || 8 |}
'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Shichiseki Kinsei''' (七赤金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the western position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}, Shichiseki Kinsei represents refined metal rather than raw ore.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, when an intercalary period is placed around the winter solstice, the first Kanoto (甲午) day within that period is designated as Shichiseki, marking the transition from Yin to Yang. At that time, the last day of the previous Yin cycle and the first day of the new Yang cycle both belong to Shichiseki, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Joy, eloquence, endings, retirement, money, arguments, celebrations, weddings, insufficiency, carelessness, sharp tongue * Love, leisure, wealth, young women, gatherings, eating * Related to the body: right lung, oral cavity, teeth, throat, bronchial tubes, nervous breakdown
